name: Cooking oil, refined sunflower / groundnut
storage: Room temperature in a cool, dark place, tightly closed; once a pouch is opened, pour it into a clean, dry bottle. Do not reuse deep-frying oil repeatedly.
looksLike: clear, pale-golden liquid in 1 L pouches, bottles or 5 L / 15 L cans. Sunflower oil is very light and mild; groundnut (peanut) oil is a deeper gold with a faint nutty smell.
howToPick: sealed pouch without leaks; clear oil with no cloudiness or sediment; check the packing date (fresher is better). Avoid a rancid or paint-like smell.
shelfLife: about 9 months from packing (Gemini pouch lists 270 days per StoreKing); use within 1–2 months of opening.

usedIn.raw: 10 ml (about 9 g, 2 tsp), groundnut or any neutral oil.
10 g in total, 5 g (1 tsp) for the tawa plus 5 g (1 tsp) for the potato masala, groundnut or sunflower.
